sections.title: Section 161 - Interest Payable by Government on Excess Payment of Advance Tax (1) If the amount of advance tax paid by a person in any financial year
sections.content_text: Section 161 - Interest Payable by Government on Excess Payment of Advance Tax (1) If the amount of advance tax paid by a person in any financial year exceeds the amount of tax assessed by the regular assessee, the Government shall pay 10% (ten percent) simple interest per annum on such excess tax paid. 2) on payment of additional advance tax under sub-section (1) from the first day of the relevant tax year to the date of assessment of regular tax for that tax year, or for a period of 2 (two years from the first day of the relevant tax year, whichever is lower, Interest has to be paid for the Moreover, as per
